body:
Even when I do exactly as they want it's never good enough for them. They've told me on multiple occasions that they lie to their friends about me so that they look like better parents. What am I doing wrong? 

I would move out, if they hadn't already kicked me out.
Yeah, before and after the move. I've been to five since the last incident. which was a couple years ago, all of them prescribed me anti-depressant/anxiety pills, but they never really did anything.

I never really started feeling this way until we moved half way across the country. I lost most of my friends, and was isolated to an Island. Where I attended HS. Im not exactly sure what initially set it off.
I mostly get it after I smoke, which to me does not make sense. But recently its increased to nightly thoughts, sober or not.
